notes: A photo gallery and editor for kosher devices: a fork of Simple Gallery Pro by kdroidFilter with video support removed by design (release note: 'Remove video mime support'). It keeps the upstream package name, so it cannot be installed next to, or over, a Simple Gallery Pro from Play, which has a different signer. The repository publishes only pre-releases, which the GitHub releases/latest endpoint does not return, so the source is the release asset itself rather than GITHUB: gallery-2-foss-release.apk from v0.1.1-pre-release (versionName 0.1.1, versionCode 2), a single universal APK. sha256 computed with apksigner from that file, single signer CN=Elyahou Hadass, O=Kdroid. No network on purpose: it is an offline gallery, and it does not request INTERNET at all. It still declares READ_MEDIA_VIDEO from upstream.
